notes.title: Version 1.1 released.
notes.notes:
Runes of Brennos 1.1 Change list:
- Certain rune combinations (e.g. water-wind) now properly block one another where they failed to do so before in certain situations.
- AI enemy now properly uses runes that it failed to use before.
- Selected arena now resets upon re-entering the campaign map window.
- Minor bugfixes
